entities.name: PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to release a PDU session when encountering invalid mandatory IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT
entities.description: 5GSM message from network accepting PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message initiated by UE to release a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: 5GSM message from network commanding PDU session release.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE
entities.description: 5GSM message sent by UE to complete PDU session release.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message from UE requesting PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: 5GSM message from network rejecting PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message from UE requesting PDU session modification.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: 5GSM message from network rejecting PDU session modification request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT
entities.description: 5GSM message from network rejecting PDU session release request.

entities.name: Error with mandatory information element
entities.description: Condition where a mandatory information element in a 5GSM message contains an error.

relations.description: Error with mandatory IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT triggers UE to initiate PDU session release procedure.
PDU session release procedure includes sending PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message.
PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message contains 5GSM cause #96.
Error with mandatory IE in PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND triggers UE to send PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE with cause #96.
PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE message contains 5GSM cause #96.
Error with mandatory IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST triggers network to send PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT with cause #96.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message contains 5GSM cause #96.
Error with mandatory IE in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST triggers network to send PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT with cause #96.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains 5GSM cause #96.
Error with mandatory IE in PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST triggers network to send PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT with cause #96.
PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message contains 5GSM cause #96.
